label: Greywatch
summary: A rowdy guild town on the lip of the Shifting Deep, a dungeon that rearranges itself every new moon. Parties go down for loot and glory.

world.era: An age of guilds and dungeon contracts
world.setting: Greywatch, a walled guild town built around the mouth of the Shifting Deep
world.description: Every new moon the Shifting Deep moves its halls, its traps and its monsters, so no map lasts. The Adventurers' Guild posts contracts on a board in the Copper Tankard, licensed parties take them, and the town lives on what comes back up: monster parts, old coins and the occasional cursed crown.
rules: Magic and monsters are real; fights are fast, loud and dangerous
Parties of four or five go down together; nobody raids alone and lives long
Loot is split by guild rules, and arguments about it are a town sport
Resting in the Deep is only safe in the rare warded rooms

narration.tone: Bold and rowdy, with real danger and warm camaraderie
